title: Q-SUBST-self-shipping: the system itself ships a change that alters behaviour at least every 48 h, with zero trivial merges
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** SUBSTANCE-1 audit 2026-11-21
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation substance --check-targets
**Status:** closed

SUBSTANCE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21). Measured 2026-11-14..21 by `python3 -m foundation substance --report`: of 192 changes the system made itself, 21 altered executable behaviour, 7 were trivial (unused imports, a bumped counter) and 164 were records; 73 of 145 deploy rounds carried no behaviour change. The executor now refuses trivial PRs and the deploy gate skips data-only pushes. This item closes when the 7-day window shows the system's own substantive share rising, zero trivial system merges, and a substantive self change inside 48 h (state `shipping`). Until then the executor takes growth and repair items that change code (EFFECT-1) before records.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 7.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
